package.name: easyfleet_easynav_farm_deployment
package.description: Single-robot deployment scenario: a Summit XL on a farm (the granja_leon world), whose EasyFleet/EasyNav nodes run under "robot_1", with a real EasyNav navigation stack (easynav_system system_main + easyfleet_easynav_deployment's navigation capability, reused as-is) localized via GPS (easynav_fusion_localizer/FusionLocalizer, fusing GPS + wheel odometry + IMU -- no distance/range sensor) against a NavMap (easynav_navmap_maps_manager/NavMapMapsManager, granja_leon.navmap), with a second maps manager (easynav_navmap_routes_maps_manager) overlaying preferred routes on top of it. launch/simulation_launch.yaml starts the Summit from easynav_playground_summit_worlds in that world. Uses rmw_zenoh_cpp by default. Pure launch/config package -- no C++ of its own.
